<h1>Opioids, Drug Policy &amp; Harm Reduction</h1>
<section class="program-overview" aria-labelledby="drug-policy-overview">
<h2 id="drug-policy-overview">Overview</h2>
<p>I study the intersection of health care regulation, substance-use policy, and drug-related harms. This work includes research on opioid prescribing, occupational licensing, cannabis access laws, industry relationships in the opioid crisis, and fentanyl test strips.</p>
